summary: Deep Frost Frostbolt with Fingers of Frost and Shatter, plus Arcane Concentration, Missile Barrage and Arcane Blast for spell damage. Client 70425 took Winter's Chill's crit and Ice Lance's fourth times, so it is 18% behind Frostfire, last of the four. High Order with a Major Spellblasting Potion.
rotation: Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial) on a free GCD
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 90 s left (almost never fires)
Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge: the boss counts as Frozen, so 3 times the damage and Shatter crit
Arcane Blast once every 15 s for 15% of Intellect as spell damage
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Ice Lance instead when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1 s)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 41 spell power and 11 crit rating, and an on-use 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.429, Season of Discovery's server value. Forever's client has 0, as SoD's did.
Frostbolt X's base damage is ×1.04, half of beta 70291's +8% raise of the low ranks. The client has ×1.00.
Winter's Chill is a Cone of Cold debuff since 70425, so the build takes none.
Assumed: raid bosses can't be frozen. Fingers of Frost charge timing is open.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII). With the books: Frost +50, Arcane +30, Fire +17, Frostfire 0.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frost unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge.
